text:
sarah.nguyen: Quick win to share — Mariner Logistics just signed a 12-month Dedicated renewal and completed their ISV listing in GCP Marketplace today. Huge props to the solutions + sales teams. :tada:
ajordan: Amazing! Was the renewal the factor that unlocked the marketplace listing or did the listing come first?
sarah.nguyen: Renewal came first — they committed to Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, then we pushed the ISV package through GCP with their help.
leo: Love it. Can we get a short case blurb + perf numbers for the sales deck? e.g., latency improvements, cost delta after batching/quantization suggestions.
emma: On it — marketing will draft a customer spot (2-3 paragraphs) and a one-slide perf snapshot. Will ping for quote approvals.
sam.csm: FYI billing/contract notes: renewal is 12 months, tier-2 SLA, includes 20% committed burst. I'll circulate the PO and renewal terms to finance.
marketplace-bot: [auto] GCP Marketplace listing status: PUBLISHED — Mariner Logistics (ISV) — listing id: ml-2026-0934.
ajordan: Any next steps for product/eng? Are there integration items we should follow up on for on-prem connectors?
sarah.nguyen: Yes — Mariner asked for help with S3-compatible connectors and a custom healthcheck for their edge nodes. @leo can you triage?
leo: Will take point. I'll open a request in eng-runtime and loop in infra for testing environments. ETA end of week.
emma: Draft will include a quote request — @sarah.nguyen can you share a short quote from the Mariner stakeholder?
sarah.nguyen: Already asked, they said "Redwood reduced our per-shipment inference cost and made scaling predictable — the Dedicated commitment was the deciding factor." I'll paste the full approval when I get it. :slightly_smiling_face:
ajordan: Nice. Can we also add a short blurb for the Partner page and a joint webinar in Q2?
emma: Webinar sounds good — I'll coordinate dates. Putting together internal launch comms for tomorrow 10am so GTM teams can amplify. :loud_sound:
sam.csm: Also adding renewal and listing details to the customer success playbook for Mariner so support has the right runbooks.
sarah.nguyen: Thanks team! Huge cross-org effort — shoutout to @sam.csm and @emma for moving the listing. :clap:
marketplace-bot: [auto] Marketplace analytics: listing impressions 120K, leads captured 8 (first 24h).
